# Go SDK for Permit.io

> The module github.com/permitio/permit-golang/v2, the Go client of Permit.io. Package permit
> asks the policy decision point (PDP) for authorization decisions, and manages the policy and
> its data, such as users, tenants, roles and resources, through the Permit API. Package models
> holds the bodies of its requests and replies. v2 is under development and is not released.

Read the README first. The API reference documents every type and method: what a call sends,
the URL it uses, the level of API key it needs, how it retries and the errors it returns.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): quick start, configuration, which URL each call uses, the PDP container
  and the cloud PDP, facts through the PDP container, API key levels, retries, errors, lists,
  logging and redaction, and the support policy
- [package permit](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/permitio/permit-golang/v2): its API reference,
  the text that go doc -all github.com/permitio/permit-golang/v2 prints
- [package models](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/permitio/permit-golang/v2/models): its API
  reference, the text that go doc -all github.com/permitio/permit-golang/v2/models prints
- [Migration guide](MIGRATION.md): each change from v1, the module
  github.com/permitio/permit-golang, and what to use instead

## Optional

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what each release changes
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): the supported versions, and how to report a vulnerability
